title: Machine learning screening finds iodobenzene vapor passivation for perovskite cells
summary: A workflow combining machine learning with first-principles calculations screened functional groups for vapor-assisted passivation molecules, and SHAP analysis identified phenyl and halogen groups as effective. Calculations indicated cation-pi interaction between Pb2+ and the benzene ring and intercalation of halogenated benzene into surface iodine vacancies. A device modified with iodobenzene vapor reached a champion power conversion efficiency of 26.94%.
ai_technology: Machine learning models with SHAP analysis combined with first-principles calculations

evidence.tested: Experimental fabrication and testing of devices with iodobenzene vapor, plus first-principles calculations.
evidence.unknown: Training data size and stability measurements not stated in the abstract; the efficiency is a champion device; full text not reviewed.
